summary: We are wired for Notification Of danger, passion And pain Gratification of life Under Fate's knife Yet, today Toolsof survival Hijacked for An Emoji smile Marketing tools Creating influential fools While identity sold Using brain wiring so Old #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
We are wired for
Notification
Of danger, passion
And pain
Gratification of life
Under Fate's knife
Yet, today
Toolsof survival
Hijacked for
An
Emoji smile
Marketing tools
Creating
influential fools
While identity sold
Using brain wiring so
Old
#smallpoems
